Twelve weeks align to the book’s full curriculum (Chapters 1–10 + 5B). Adjust pacing for shorter terms by merging Weeks 5–6 or running capstone as a studio intensive.

Week Focus Primary chapters Core artifacts
1 HCD foundations, gulfs, models 1 Gulf map; conceptual-model one-pager draft
2 Interaction, flows, feedback 2 Critical-path flow + failure states
3 Inclusive design & AT ladder 3 Persona Spectrum constraints; AT ladder steps 1–3
4 Strategy & continuous discovery 4 Assumption map; opportunity framing
5 Design systems & state completeness 5 Component state matrix (starter)
6 Visual craft, IA, prototyping 5B Prototype + IA outline; handoff notes
7 Content, trust, privacy, service 6 Content/Privacy DoD pass on one flow
8 Research methods & evidence bars 7 + App. I Study plan; heuristic or walkthrough write-up
9 Modern contexts (mobile, multi-modal, AI) 8 Constraint scenario + AI/interrupt risks
10 Operating practice 9 Monday loop live; midweek gate calendar
11–12 Cases & capstone 10 Capstone package; teaching artifact

Graded artifact rubrics (pass tied to book DoDs)

(1) Monday one-pager. Pass: Names problem/job, segment, critical constraints (AT/connectivity/shared device as relevant), non-goals, success metrics + evidence bar, ranked priority stack (≤ one true P0), open assumptions, Risks & DoD status for applicable domains (Auth, Privacy, Interrupt, Content, Activation, Support, AI if in scope), and links to research/prototype/decision log. Fail: branding brief only; twelve P0s; no DoD status; metrics without decisions.

(2) State matrix + midweek gate. Pass: Matrix covers default through focus-visible, disabled, loading, error, empty, and constraint states (offline/permission/partial failure where relevant); acceptance criteria are engineer-verifiable without Figma; gate states decision question, evidence required, decider, default = no-ship. Fail: happy-path-only matrix; gate with no default; “design approved” without DoD scan.

(3) AT test script run. Pass: Script covers critical path; evidence of ladder progress (at least automated + keyboard + screen-reader smoke, or documented equivalent); issues logged by POUR with severity by user impact; blockers tied to ship/no-ship. Fail: green axe score alone; no keyboard pass; AT deferred to “later.”

(4) Capstone. Pass: Living one-pager; prototype including failure/empty/offline/interrupt (and AI confirm/provenance if AI slice); evidence summary with honest sample limits; DoD sign-off for risk domains in play; metrics that detect silent failure; midweek-style go/no-go with default no; demo + teaching artifact (checklist or anti-pattern amendment). Harm reduction and recoverability outweigh visual novelty. Fail: restyle without gates; vanity metrics; no constraint-matched research; ship recommendation with open catastrophic DoD gaps.

Course pass criteria. Credit requires passing artifacts (1)–(4) at the bars above, plus participation in Monday loops and critiques using the Chapter 9 anti-pattern table. Methods from Appendix I may support evidence but never substitute for DoD-tied gates. Grade process honesty equal to craft: an elegant UI that fails Interrupt or AT DoDs does not pass.

Appendix L — Instructor Exemplars (v2.1)

Part of textbook v2.2. Filled examples for teaching and grading. Pair with Chapter 9 (operating practice), Chapter 4 (OST), Chapter 5 (state matrices), and Appendix K rubrics. Students may adapt structure; inventing empty theater does not pass.

These exemplars show what a pass looks like in prose—not templates to copy wholesale. Use them in studio critiques and grading calibration.

L1 — Exemplar Monday one-pager (delivery-time modify)

Squad: Field Inventory · Week of 2026-03-09
Outcome pulse: Cut wrong-SKU receives on intermittent warehouse Wi‑Fi without adding irreversible side effects under interrupt.

Field Content
Problem / job When a receiver is mid-count and connectivity drops, they need to modify delivery quantity/notes on a line and resume without restarting the receipt—so inventory stays honest and dock time does not explode.
Segment & constraints Warehouse associates; shared tablets; gloves; intermittent Wi‑Fi; occasional VoiceOver/TalkBack; hurried shifts. Persona Spectrum: temporary (one free hand), situational (bright aisle glare).
Non-goals Redesign put-away; new analytics dashboard; AI auto-correct of quantities this sprint.
Success metrics + evidence bar Primary: % of modify-quantity tasks completed offline→sync without restart or silent overwrite. Guardrails: duplicate-receive rate, support tickets tagged receive-conflict, AT critical-path blockers = 0. Evidence bar: ship only if (a) 5 task sessions under airplane-mode→reconnect include ≥1 AT user and show no catastrophic sync loss, and (b) Interrupt + Support DoD checklist signed. SUS alone does not clear the bar.
Priority stack P0: Offline modify + visible sync/conflict for delivery lines (displaces “bulk photo upload polish”). P1: Conflict copy + citeable receipt ID. P2 (parked): Suggested qty from ASN—revisit after sync honesty ships.
Open assumptions A1: Receivers understand “queued locally” vs “confirmed on server.” A2: Conflict resolution “keep mine / keep server” is learnable in <30s. Highest risk × ignorance: A1.
Risks & DoD status Interrupt: draft durability on qty/notes — in progress. Auth: shared-tablet lock — met. Privacy: no PII in lock-screen banners — met. Support: conflict events in dictionary — gap (owner: PM). Content: empty/offline copy — in progress. AI: N/A.
Links Research notes #recv-offline-12; prototype proto/recv-modify-v3; decision log ADR-041; event dictionary recv.modify.*.

Why this passes. It names a job under constraint, one true P0 with displacement, metrics that detect silent failure, an evidence bar tied to methods, and honest DoD gaps with owners. A branding paragraph (“delightful receiving experience”) with twelve P0s would fail Appendix K.

L2 — Exemplar state matrix (offline inventory)

Three objects × key states for offline receiving. Acceptance criteria must be engineer-verifiable without opening Figma.

Object Default Loading Empty Error Offline / queued Sync conflict Success / confirmed Disabled / focus-visible
Receipt header Shows site, PO#, actor Skeleton; “Loading receipt…” N/A once opened “Can’t load receipt” + retry + citeable ID Banner: “Working offline · changes queue on device” Banner: “Server differs · resolve before submit” “Synced · server confirmed 14:02” Submit disabled until lines valid; focus ring on Retry
Line item (SKU) Qty, unit, notes Row shimmer “No lines—scan or add” + primary CTA Inline “Save failed” on that row Badge Queued; qty editable locally Row highlight; Keep mine / Keep server Check + server qty Qty stepper disabled if receipt locked; focus order: SKU → qty → notes
Modify qty control Stepper + confirm Brief progress on confirm N/A “Couldn’t apply change” + undo restore Applies locally; announces via live region Blocked until conflict choice Live region: “Quantity 12, queued” then “confirmed” Min hit area ≥ WCAG; keyboard ±; AT name includes SKU

Sample acceptance criteria. (1) With network off, changing qty persists after app background ≥5 min and shows Queued. (2) On reconnect with server mismatch, neither value silently wins—user chooses Keep mine/Keep server; choice logged. (3) Screen reader announces queued→confirmed transition without focus trap.

Midweek gate (attach). Decision: “Ship offline modify for receipts?” Evidence: matrix AC green + 5 constrained sessions + Support dictionary entries. Decider: EM + Design lead. Default if undecided: no-ship.

L3 — Exemplar OST snippet with evidence bar

Desired outcome: Reduce dock rework from wrong or lost quantity edits during intermittent connectivity (proxy: conflict/rework tickets per 1k receives ↓ 40% in pilot site).

Outcome: Honest qty edits under flaky Wi‑Fi
├─ Opportunity: Receivers lose in-progress edits when the app reloads
│  ├─ Solution: Local draft durability + resume point on receipt
│  │  └─ Experiment: Prototype offline edit; task success offline→online
│  │     Evidence bar: ≥4/5 complete modify without restart; 0 silent overwrites
│  └─ Solution: Autosave every keystroke to server only
│     └─ Experiment: Kill—fails offline constraint (do not run)
└─ Opportunity: Receivers don’t trust whether the count “took”
   ├─ Solution: Explicit queued vs confirmed system status
   │  └─ Experiment: Comprehension probe after task (teach-back)
   │     Evidence bar: 4/5 correctly explain queued≠confirmed; else rewrite copy
   └─ Solution: Push notification “sync done”
      └─ Experiment: Parked—lock-screen privacy risk on shared tablets

Evidence bar (team contract). Opportunity ranking requires ≥2 independent signals (support themes + observed task failure) before a solution enters P0. Solution ship requires behavioral task evidence under the stated constraint—not preference votes or heuristic-only pass. Sample limits stated in the write-up (n=5, one AT user, one site)—no fake power claims.

L4 — Grading annotation: pass vs theater

Artifact signal Pass Theater (fail)
One-pager Job + constraints; one P0 with displacement; metrics change decisions; DoD gaps owned Vision poster; vanity KPIs; twelve P0s; “TBD accessibility”
State matrix Offline/conflict/AT focus included; AC testable without Figma Happy path only; “error TBD”; screenshots as “done”
OST / evidence Outcome→opportunity→experiment; pre-committed bar; honest n Solution-first tree; “users will love it”; SUS as ship gate
Gates Yes/no question, named decider, default no-ship “Align async”; silence = yes; design approved without DoD scan
Research Constraint-matched recruits; assumptions retired explicitly Five friends on campus Wi‑Fi; confirmation of the preferred mock

Instructor note. Grade process honesty equal to craft polish. An elegant UI that fails Interrupt or AT DoDs does not pass—even if the critique vocabulary is fluent. Reward students who demote work, record unknowns, and refuse to ship on theater.
